trap.label: modal + to
trap.why: Em português dizemos “pode estar atrasada” sem problema, mas o brasileiro tende a inserir to após modais. Em inglês, modais (should, must, might, could) vêm direto com o verbo base.

mcq.q: They have ___ waiting for an hour.

fix.right: I have been waiting since noon.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com have been: “I wait for an hour.”
rewrite.answer: I have been waiting for an hour.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “We make a list.”
